title: Qualify both Commons Collections iterator PRs and their four endpoints
description: Use the unchanged change-plan implementation and one public observer for the original #628 optimization and #755 repair. Check parent and child locks, next and remove provenance, late attachment, overrides, unmodifiable boundaries and both backing lists; compare each pair cold, warm and clean. Run the upstream depth-150 workload in three fresh JVMs per endpoint and distinguish bounded timing from a traversal invariant.

steps.name: Check the optimization on its own original pair
steps.run: python3 -B lib/benchmark/organic-composition/matrix.py collections-628 first && python3 -B lib/benchmark/organic-composition/audit.py collections-628 first

steps.name: Check the repair on its own original pair
steps.run: python3 -B lib/benchmark/organic-composition/matrix.py collections-755 first && python3 -B lib/benchmark/organic-composition/audit.py collections-755 first
